## midaffemo 1 (only pupil GLM; in SI)

### make dataframe of all similarities, all thresholds
```{r}
subjects_list<-read_delim('~/Desktop/midaffemo/analyses/subjects-pupil-fmri.txt',delim = '\t', col_names = F)
thresh_str <- c("0","05","1","15","2","25","3","35")
thresh <- c(0,0.5,1,1.5,2,2.5,3,3.5)

glmArousal_array <- NULL
glmPupil_array <- NULL
glmPupil_posonly_array <- NULL
pupil_array <- NULL

for (t in 1:length(thresh_str)){
  filepath = paste0("~/Desktop/midaffemo/glm_maps/glm27_array_threshold",thresh_str[t],".csv")
  glmArousal_array<-rbind(glmArousal_array,
                          as.data.frame(t(read_csv(filepath, 
                                           col_names = F))) %>% 
                            mutate(type = "glmArousal", 
                                   tr = row_number(), 
                                   threshold = thresh[t]) #self-reported arousal GLM
  )
  
  filepath = paste0("~/Desktop/midaffemo/glm_maps/glm33b_array_threshold",thresh_str[t],".csv")
  glmPupil_array<-rbind(glmPupil_array,
                        as.data.frame(t(read_csv(filepath, 
             col_names = F))) %>% 
    mutate(type = "glmPupil", tr = row_number(), 
                                   threshold = thresh[t])) #pupil GLM
  
  filepath = paste0("~/Desktop/midaffemo/glm_maps/glm33b_posonly_array_threshold",thresh_str[t],".csv")
  glmPupil_posonly_array<-rbind(glmPupil_posonly_array,
                        as.data.frame(t(read_csv(filepath, 
             col_names = F))) %>% 
    mutate(type = "glmPupil_posonly", tr = row_number(), 
                                   threshold = thresh[t])) #pupil GLM (pos only)
  
  pupil_array<-rbind(pupil_array,
                     as.data.frame(t(read_csv("~/Desktop/midaffemo/glm_maps/pupil_array.csv", col_names = F))) %>% 
    mutate(type = "pupil", tr = row_number(), 
                                   threshold = thresh[t])) #pupil time series
}
```

### self-reported arousal template (circular; just for visualisation)
```{r}
my_array__ <- my_array%>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(trial,subject,tr_in_trial,glmArousal,trial_tr,threshold) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(tr_in_trial), values_from = c(glmArousal), names_prefix = "glmArousal_TR_") %>% 
  arrange(subject,trial)

for (t in thresh){
  for (sub in unique(my_array__$subject)){
    for(tr in 9:11){
      replace_idx = my_array__$subject == sub & my_array__$trial_tr == tr & my_array__$threshold == t & is.na(my_array__[,paste0("glmArousal_TR_",tr+1)])
      #early TRs were TRs from the previous trial
      my_array__[replace_idx,paste0("glmArousal_TR_",(tr+1):TR_DELAY)] <- my_array__[lag(replace_idx) %>% replace_na(FALSE),paste0("glmArousal_TR_",1:(TR_DELAY-tr))]
  } # tr loop
  }
}

TR_DELAY = 14
my_array__ <- my_array__ %>% mutate(glmArousal_TR_17 = NA, glmArousal_TR_18 = NA, glmArousal_TR_19 = NA, glmArousal_TR_20 = NA)

my_array__<-left_join(my_array__ %>% 
                        pivot_longer(glmArousal_TR_1:glmArousal_TR_20,
                                     names_to = "tr_in_trial",names_prefix = "glmArousal_TR_",
                                     values_to = "glmArousal"),fmri3_data_2probes,
                      by = c("subject","trial")) %>% 
  filter(tr <= 975)%>%
  mutate(half = ifelse(trial >= 48,"second","first"))%>% #last bit was interpolated
  mutate(probe = ifelse(probe == 1, "anticipation probe","outcome probe"))

my_array__ <- my_array__ %>% 
  mutate(tr_in_trial = as.numeric(tr_in_trial),
         time = (tr_in_trial-1) * 2)
```

#### predicting performance
```{r warning=F}
df_performance <- NULL
for (t in thresh){
  for (tr in 1:14){
    l1<-summary(glm(hit_num ~ scale(glmArousal),family = binomial,
                    my_array__ %>% 
                      filter(tr_in_trial == tr,threshold == t, probe == "anticipation probe") %>% 
                      mutate(hit_num = as.factor(hit == 1))))
    
    l2<-summary(glm(hit_num ~ scale(glmArousal),family = binomial,
                    my_array__ %>% 
                      filter(tr_in_trial == tr,threshold == t, probe == "outcome probe") %>% 
                      mutate(hit_num = as.factor(hit == 1))))
  
    df_performance <- rbind(df_performance,
                          l1$coefficients[2,],
                          l2$coefficients[2,])
  }
  
}

df_performance <- as.data.frame(df_performance)
df_performance$probe <- rep(c("anticipation","outcome"), length(thresh))
df_performance$threshold <- rep(thresh, each = 2*14)
df_performance$tr <- rep(rep(1:14,each=2),2)

ggplot(df_performance, aes(x = tr, y = Estimate))+
  geom_line(aes(color= probe))+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey",
             size = 1)+
  facet_wrap(~threshold)+
    scale_color_manual(values = c("purple","skyblue"))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("purple","skyblue"))+
```

```{r warning=F}
                                                                    c("+$0","-$0"),1,NA))))))
    
    l2<-summary(lm(cue_value_abs ~ scale(glmArousal),
                    my_array__ %>% 
                      filter(tr_in_trial == tr,threshold == t, probe == "outcome probe") %>% 
                      mutate(cue_value_abs = ifelse(cue_value %in% c("+$5","-$5"),5,
                                                    ifelse(cue_value %in% c("+$1","-$1"),1,
                                                           ifelse(cue_value %in% 
                                                                    c("+$0","-$0"),1,NA))))))
  
    df_cue <- rbind(df_cue,
                          l1$coefficients[2,],
                          l2$coefficients[2,])
  }
  
}
```

### pupil glm template
```{r}
my_array_ <- my_array%>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(trial,subject,tr_in_trial,glmPupil,trial_tr,threshold) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(tr_in_trial), values_from = c(glmPupil), names_prefix = "glmPupil_TR_") %>% 
  arrange(subject,trial)

for (t in thresh){
  for (sub in unique(my_array_$subject)){
    for(tr in 9:11){
      replace_idx = my_array_$subject == sub & my_array_$trial_tr == tr & my_array_$threshold == t & is.na(my_array_[,paste0("glmPupil_TR_",tr+1)])
      #early TRs were TRs from the previous trial
      my_array_[replace_idx,paste0("glmPupil_TR_",(tr+1):TR_DELAY)] <- my_array_[lag(replace_idx) %>% replace_na(FALSE),paste0("glmPupil_TR_",1:(TR_DELAY-tr))]
  } # tr loop
  }
}

TR_DELAY = 14
my_array_ <- my_array_ %>% mutate(glmPupil_TR_17 = NA, glmPupil_TR_18 = NA, glmPupil_TR_19 = NA, glmPupil_TR_20 = NA)

my_array_<-left_join(my_array_ %>% 
                        pivot_longer(glmPupil_TR_1:glmPupil_TR_20,
                                     names_to = "tr_in_trial",names_prefix = "glmPupil_TR_",
                                     values_to = "glmPupil"),fmri3_data_2probes,
                      by = c("subject","trial")) %>% 
  filter(tr <= 975)%>%
  mutate(half = ifelse(trial >= 48,"second","first"))%>% #last bit was interpolated
  mutate(probe = ifelse(probe == 1, "anticipation probe","outcome probe"))

my_array_ <- my_array_ %>% 
  mutate(tr_in_trial = as.numeric(tr_in_trial),
         time = (tr_in_trial-1) * 2)
```

### pupil glm template (positive values only)
```{r}
my_array_ <- my_array%>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(trial,subject,tr_in_trial,glmPupil_posonly,trial_tr,threshold) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(tr_in_trial), values_from = c(glmPupil_posonly), names_prefix = "glmPupil_TR_") %>% 
  arrange(subject,trial)

for (t in thresh){
  for (sub in unique(my_array_$subject)){
    for(tr in 9:11){
      replace_idx = my_array_$subject == sub & my_array_$trial_tr == tr & my_array_$threshold == t & is.na(my_array_[,paste0("glmPupil_TR_",tr+1)])
      #early TRs were TRs from the previous trial
      my_array_[replace_idx,paste0("glmPupil_TR_",(tr+1):TR_DELAY)] <- my_array_[lag(replace_idx) %>% replace_na(FALSE),paste0("glmPupil_TR_",1:(TR_DELAY-tr))]
  } # tr loop
  }
}

TR_DELAY = 14
my_array_ <- my_array_ %>% mutate(glmPupil_TR_17 = NA, glmPupil_TR_18 = NA, glmPupil_TR_19 = NA, glmPupil_TR_20 = NA)

my_array_<-left_join(my_array_ %>% 
                        pivot_longer(glmPupil_TR_1:glmPupil_TR_20,
                                     names_to = "tr_in_trial",names_prefix = "glmPupil_TR_",
                                     values_to = "glmPupil"),fmri3_data_2probes,
                      by = c("subject","trial")) %>% 
  filter(tr <= 975)%>%
  mutate(half = ifelse(trial >= 48,"second","first"))%>% #last bit was interpolated
  mutate(probe = ifelse(probe == 1, "anticipation probe","outcome probe"))

my_array_ <- my_array_ %>% 
  mutate(tr_in_trial = as.numeric(tr_in_trial),
         time = (tr_in_trial-1) * 2)
```


### predicting self-reports
```{r}
df_rating <- NULL
for (t in thresh){
  for (tr in 1:14){
    l1<-summary(lm(scale(arousal) ~ scale(glmPupil),
                    my_array_ %>% 
                      filter(tr_in_trial == tr,threshold == t, probe == "anticipation probe")))
    l2<-summary(lm(scale(arousal) ~ scale(glmPupil),
                   my_array_ %>% 
                   filter(tr_in_trial == tr, threshold == t, probe == "outcome probe")))
  
    df_rating <- rbind(df_rating,
                          l1$coefficients[2,],
                          l2$coefficients[2,])
  }
  
}

df_rating <- as.data.frame(df_rating)
```

### make dataframe of all similarities, all thresholds
```{r}
subjects_list<-read_delim('~/Desktop/midaffemo2/analyses/subjects-pupil-fmri.txt',delim = '\t', col_names = F)

glmArousal_array <- NULL
glmPupil_array <- NULL
glmPupil_posonly_array <- NULL
pupil_array <- NULL

for (t in 1:length(thresh_str)){
  filepath = paste0("~/Desktop/midaffemo2/glm_maps/glm27_array_templatefromstudy1_threshold",thresh_str[t],".csv")
  glmArousal_array<-rbind(glmArousal_array,
                          as.data.frame(t(read_csv(filepath, 
                                           col_names = F))) %>% 
                            mutate(type = "glmArousal", 
                                   tr = row_number(), 
                                   threshold = thresh[t]) #self-reported arousal GLM
  )
  
  filepath = paste0("~/Desktop/midaffemo2/glm_maps/glm33b_array_templatefromstudy1_threshold",thresh_str[t],".csv")
  glmPupil_array<-rbind(glmPupil_array,
                        as.data.frame(t(read_csv(filepath, 
             col_names = F))) %>% 
    mutate(type = "glmPupil", tr = row_number(), 
                                   threshold = thresh[t])) #pupil GLM
  
  filepath = paste0("~/Desktop/midaffemo2/glm_maps/glm33b_posonly_array_templatefromstudy1_threshold",thresh_str[t],".csv")
  glmPupil_posonly_array<-rbind(glmPupil_posonly_array,
                        as.data.frame(t(read_csv(filepath, 
             col_names = F))) %>% 
    mutate(type = "glmPupil_posonly", tr = row_number(), 
                                   threshold = thresh[t])) #pupil GLM
  
  pupil_array<-rbind(pupil_array,
                     as.data.frame(t(read_csv("~/Desktop/midaffemo2/glm_maps/pupil_array.csv", col_names = F))) %>% 
    mutate(type = "pupil", tr = row_number(), 
                                   threshold = thresh[t])) #pupil time series
}
```

```{r}
         summarise(glmArousal = mean(glmArousal,na.rm = T)) %>% 
         group_by(threshold,cue_value) %>% 
         summarise(mean = mean(glmArousal,na.rm = T),
                   se = sd(glmArousal,na.rm = T)/sqrt(n())) %>% 
  mutate(cue_value = factor(cue_value, levels = c("-$5","-$1","-$0","+$0","+$1","+$5")))

summary(l1<-lm(scale(glmArousal) ~ cue_value,
                   my_array__ %>% 
                   filter(tr_in_trial == 5, hit == 1,threshold == 0.5)))

# Get effect size (standardized beta)
r2   <- summary(l1)$r.squared

p2m2a<-ggplot(d2 %>% filter(threshold == 0.5),
       aes(x = cue_value, y = mean,color = cue_value))+
  geom_point(size = 0.5) +
  geom_point()+
  geom_errorbar(aes(x = cue_value, ymin = mean-se,ymax = mean+se), width = 0.3)+
  labs(y = "Simalirty",
       x = "time (s)",
       subtitle = "TR 5 arousal index")+
  scale_color_manual(values = redOrange_palette6)+
  theme(legend.position = "none")+  # show shape legend
  scale_x_discrete(breaks =c("-$5","-$1","-$0","+$0","+$1","+$5"))+
  annotate("text",x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = paste0("R² = ", round(r2, 2)),
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = -1.5, size = 4)

d3<-my_array_ %>% 
         filter(!is.na(hit),
                ifelse(probe == "anticipation probe", tr_in_trial == 12,
                       ifelse(probe == "outcome probe",tr_in_trial == 7,NA))) %>% 
         group_by(subject,threshold,hit,cue_value) %>% 
         summarise(glmPupil = mean(glmPupil,na.rm = T)) %>% 
         group_by(threshold,hit,cue_value) %>% 
         summarise(mean = mean(glmPupil,na.rm = T),
                   se = sd(glmPupil,na.rm = T)/sqrt(n())) %>% 
  mutate(hit = factor(hit, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("Miss","Hit")))%>% 
  mutate(cue_value = factor(cue_value, levels = c("-$5","-$1","-$0","+$0","+$1","+$5")))

ggplot(d3 %>% filter(threshold == 0.5),
       aes(x = cue_value, y = mean, color = cue_value, shape = hit)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(x = cue_value, group = hit, ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se),
                width = 0.3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  labs(y = "Similarity",
       x = "time (s)",
       subtitle = "arousal index during outcome") +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  scale_color_manual(values = redOrange_palette6) +
  guides(color = "none",  # hide color legend
         shape = guide_legend())+  # show shape legend
  scale_x_discrete(breaks =c("-$5","-$1","-$0","+$0","+$1","+$5"))
```

### pupil glm template
```{r}
my_array_ <- my_array%>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(trial,subject,tr_in_trial,glmPupil,trial_tr,threshold) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(tr_in_trial), values_from = c(glmPupil), names_prefix = "glmPupil_TR_") %>% 
  arrange(subject,trial)

for (t in thresh){
  for (sub in unique(my_array_$subject)){
    for(tr in 9:11){
      replace_idx = my_array_$subject == sub & my_array_$trial_tr == tr & my_array_$threshold == t & is.na(my_array_[,paste0("glmPupil_TR_",tr+1)])
      #early TRs were TRs from the previous trial
      my_array_[replace_idx,paste0("glmPupil_TR_",(tr+1):TR_DELAY)] <- my_array_[lag(replace_idx) %>% replace_na(FALSE),paste0("glmPupil_TR_",1:(TR_DELAY-tr))]
  } # tr loop
  }
}

TR_DELAY = 14
my_array_ <- my_array_ %>% mutate(glmPupil_TR_17 = NA, glmPupil_TR_18 = NA, glmPupil_TR_19 = NA, glmPupil_TR_20 = NA)

my_array_<-left_join(my_array_ %>% 
                        pivot_longer(glmPupil_TR_1:glmPupil_TR_20,
                                     names_to = "tr_in_trial",names_prefix = "glmPupil_TR_",
                                     values_to = "glmPupil"),fmri4_data_2probes,
                      by = c("subject","trial")) %>% 
  filter(tr <= 975)%>%
  mutate(half = ifelse(trial >= 48,"second","first"))%>% #last bit was interpolated
  mutate(probe = ifelse(probe == 1, "anticipation probe","outcome probe"))

my_array_ <- my_array_ %>% 
  mutate(tr_in_trial = as.numeric(tr_in_trial),
         time = (tr_in_trial-1) * 2)
```

```{r}
         summarise(glmPupil = mean(glmPupil,na.rm = T)) %>% 
         group_by(threshold,cue_value) %>% 
         summarise(mean = mean(glmPupil,na.rm = T),
                   se = sd(glmPupil,na.rm = T)/sqrt(n())) %>% 
  mutate(cue_value = factor(cue_value,levels = c("-$5","-$1","-$0","+$0","+$1","+$5")))

summary(l1<-lm(glmPupil~cue_value,my_array_))
r2   <- summary(l1)$r.squared

p2m2p<-ggplot(d2 %>% filter(threshold == 0.5),
       aes(x = cue_value, y = mean,color = cue_value))+
  geom_point(size = 0.5) +
  geom_point()+
  geom_errorbar(aes(x = cue_value, ymin = mean-se,ymax = mean+se), width = 0.3)+
  labs(y = "Simalirty",
       x = "time (s)",
       subtitle = "TR 5 arousal index")+
  scale_color_manual(values = redOrange_palette6)+
  theme(legend.position = "none")+  # show shape legend
  scale_x_discrete(breaks =c("-$5","-$1","-$0","+$0","+$1","+$5"))+
  annotate("text",x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = paste0("R² = ", round(r2, 3)),
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = -1.5, size = 4)# Get effect size (standardized beta)

d3<-my_array_ %>% 
         filter(!is.na(hit),
                ifelse(probe == "anticipation probe", tr_in_trial == 12,
                       ifelse(probe == "outcome probe",tr_in_trial == 7,NA))) %>% 
         group_by(subject,threshold,hit,cue_value) %>% 
         summarise(glmPupil = mean(glmPupil,na.rm = T)) %>% 
         group_by(threshold,hit,cue_value) %>% 
         summarise(mean = mean(glmPupil,na.rm = T),
                   se = sd(glmPupil,na.rm = T)/sqrt(n())) %>% 
  mutate(hit = factor(hit, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("Miss","Hit")))%>% 
  mutate(cue_value = factor(cue_value,levels = c("-$5","-$1","-$0","+$0","+$1","+$5")))

ggplot(d3 %>% filter(threshold == 0.5),
       aes(x = cue_value, y = mean, color = cue_value, shape = hit)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(x = cue_value, group = hit, ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se),
                width = 0.3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  labs(y = "Similarity to self-report template",
       x = "time (s)",
       subtitle = "arousal index during outcome") +
  theme(legend.position = "top") +
  scale_color_manual(values = redOrange_palette6) +
  guides(color = "none",  # hide color legend
         shape = guide_legend())+  # show shape legend
```

### pupil glm template (positive activations only)
```{r}
my_array_ <- my_array%>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(trial,subject,tr_in_trial,glmPupil_posonly,trial_tr,threshold) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(tr_in_trial), values_from = c(glmPupil_posonly), names_prefix = "glmPupil_TR_") %>% 
  arrange(subject,trial)

for (t in thresh){
  for (sub in unique(my_array_$subject)){
    for(tr in 9:11){
      replace_idx = my_array_$subject == sub & my_array_$trial_tr == tr & my_array_$threshold == t & is.na(my_array_[,paste0("glmPupil_TR_",tr+1)])
      #early TRs were TRs from the previous trial
      my_array_[replace_idx,paste0("glmPupil_TR_",(tr+1):TR_DELAY)] <- my_array_[lag(replace_idx) %>% replace_na(FALSE),paste0("glmPupil_TR_",1:(TR_DELAY-tr))]
  } # tr loop
  }
}

TR_DELAY = 14
my_array_ <- my_array_ %>% mutate(glmPupil_TR_17 = NA, glmPupil_TR_18 = NA, glmPupil_TR_19 = NA, glmPupil_TR_20 = NA)

my_array_<-left_join(my_array_ %>% 
                        pivot_longer(glmPupil_TR_1:glmPupil_TR_20,
                                     names_to = "tr_in_trial",names_prefix = "glmPupil_TR_",
                                     values_to = "glmPupil"),fmri4_data_2probes,
                      by = c("subject","trial")) %>% 
  filter(tr <= 975)%>%
  mutate(half = ifelse(trial >= 48,"second","first"))%>% #last bit was interpolated
  mutate(probe = ifelse(probe == 1, "anticipation probe","outcome probe"))

my_array_ <- my_array_ %>% 
  mutate(tr_in_trial = as.numeric(tr_in_trial),
         time = (tr_in_trial-1) * 2)
```

```{r}
  mutate(hit = factor(hit, levels = c(0,1), labels = c("Miss","Hit")))%>%
```

#### predicting performance
```{r warning=F}
df_performance <- NULL
for (t in thresh){
  for (tr in 1:14){
    l1<-summary(glm(hit_num ~ scale(glmPupil),family = binomial,
                    my_array_ %>% 
                      filter(tr_in_trial == tr,threshold == t, probe == "anticipation probe") %>% 
                      mutate(hit_num = as.factor(hit == 1))))
    
    l2<-summary(glm(hit_num ~ scale(glmPupil),family = binomial,
                    my_array_ %>% 
                      filter(tr_in_trial == tr,threshold == t, probe == "outcome probe") %>% 
                      mutate(hit_num = as.factor(hit == 1))))
  
    df_performance <- rbind(df_performance,
                          l1$coefficients[2,],
                          l2$coefficients[2,])
  }
  
}

df_performance <- as.data.frame(df_performance)
df_performance$probe <- rep(c("anticipation","outcome"), length(thresh))
df_performance$threshold <- rep(thresh, each = 2*14)
df_performance$tr <- rep(rep(1:14,each=2),2)

ggplot(df_performance, aes(x = tr, y = Estimate))+
  geom_line(aes(color= probe))+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey",
             size = 1)+
  facet_wrap(~threshold)+
    scale_color_manual(values = c("purple","skyblue"))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("purple","skyblue"))+
  labs(title = "FMRI study")+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:14)


ggplot(df_performance %>% filter(tr == 5), aes(x = threshold, y = Estimate))+
  geom_line(aes(color= probe))+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey",
             size = 1)+
    scale_color_manual(values = c("purple","skyblue"))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("purple","skyblue"))+
  labs(title = "FMRI study")+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:14)

summary(l1<-glm(hit_num ~ scale(glmPupil),family = binomial,
                    my_array_ %>% 
                      filter(tr_in_trial == 5,threshold == 0.5) %>% 
                      mutate(hit_num = as.factor(hit == 1))))

# Get effect size (standardized beta)
beta <- summary(l1)$coefficients["scale(glmPupil)", "Estimate"]
r2   <- pscl::pR2(l1)["McFadden"]

# Create base plot
plot_model(l1, type = "pred", terms = "glmPupil",color = "darkgrey") +
  labs(x = "similarity (z-score)",
       y = "p(hit)",title = "p(hit)") +
  annotate("text",x = Inf, y = -Inf, label = paste0("β = ", round(beta, 2), "\npseudo-R² = ", round(r2, 2)),
    hjust = 1.1, vjust = -0.5, size = 4)
```

```{r}
df_rating <- NULL

                    my_array_ %>%

    l2<-summary(lm(scale(arousal_scaled) ~ scale(glmPupil),
                   my_array_ %>% 
                   filter(tr_in_trial == tr, threshold == t, probe == "outcome probe")))
  
    df_rating <- rbind(df_rating,
                          l1$coefficients[2,],
                          l2$coefficients[2,])
  }
  
}

df_rating <- as.data.frame(df_rating)
df_rating$probe <- rep(c("anticipation","outcome"), length(thresh))

df_rating$tr <- rep(rep(1:14,each=2),2)

  geom_line(aes(color= probe))+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey",
             size = 1)+
  geom_ribbon(aes(x = tr, ymin = Estimate - `Std. Error`,

              alpha = 0.1)+

  geom_vline(xintercept = 7, color = "purple", linetype = "dashed")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = 9, color = "skyblue", linetype = "dashed")
  
  ggplot(df_rating %>% filter(tr == 5), aes(x = threshold, y = Estimate))+

  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey",
             size = 1)+
    scale_color_manual(values = c("purple","skyblue"))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("purple","skyblue"))+
  labs(title = "FMRI study")+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:14)
```

### visualize peak correlation
```{r}
coefs1 = NULL
for (t in 1:14){
  l1<-summary(lm(scale(glmPupil) ~ scale(arousal_scaled),my_array_ %>% filter(tr_in_trial == t, probe == "anticipation probe", threshold == 0.5)))
  coefs1 <- rbind(coefs1,l1$coefficients[2,])
}

coefs1<-as.data.frame(coefs1)
coefs1$TR <- 1:14
coefs1$probe = "anticipation probe"

coefs2 = NULL
for (t in 1:14){
  l1<-summary(lm(scale(glmPupil) ~ scale(arousal_scaled),my_array_ %>% filter(tr_in_trial == t, probe == "outcome probe", threshold == 0.5)))
  coefs2 <- rbind(coefs2,l1$coefficients[2,])
}
coefs2<-as.data.frame(coefs2)
coefs2$TR <- 1:14
coefs2$probe = "outcome probe"

coefs <- rbind(coefs1,coefs2) %>% 
  mutate(sig = ifelse(`Pr(>|t|)` >= 0.05, "",
                      ifelse(`Pr(>|t|)` >= 0.01, "*",
                             ifelse(`Pr(>|t|)` >= 0.001, "**","***"))))

p_m2_pupil_posonly_a<-ggplot(coefs %>% filter(probe == "anticipation probe"),aes(x = TR, y =Estimate))+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed")+
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(3.5,4.5,5.5,9.5,10.5,11.5,12.5), size = 1, color = "grey")+
  annotate("text",x = 4, y = 0.05, label = "C")+
  annotate("text",x = 5, y = 0.05, label = "F")+
  annotate("text",x = 10, y = 0.05, label = "F")+
  annotate("text",x = 11, y = 0.05, label = "T")+
  annotate("text",x = 12, y = 0.05, label = "O")+
  annotate("text",x = 7.5, y = 0.05, label = "R")+
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0,14,2), labels = seq(0,28,4))+
  scale_color_manual(values = c("purple"))+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("purple"))+
  geom_line(aes(color = probe), size = 2, alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_ribbon(aes(fill = probe, ymin = Estimate - `Std. Error`,
                  ymax = Estimate + `Std. Error`), alpha = 0.1)+
  geom_line(aes(color = probe), size = 2, alpha = 0.5)+
  geom_segment(aes(x = 7, y = 0.15,
                   xend =7, yend = 0.1),
               size = 1, arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.03, "npc")),
               color = "darkgrey")+
  annotate("text",x = 7, y = 0.16, label ="arousal rating")+
  geom_text(aes(x = TR, y = Estimate+0.01, label = sig, color = probe))+
  labs(x = "time (s)",
       y = "Correlation with arousal ratings",
       title = "Regression weights on arousal",
       subtitle = "anticipation probe")+
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```
